name: Eat Your Heart Valentine 2
source:
No job. No boyfriend. Rent’s coming due. Valentine’s Day is on the way.

Let’s get you a job, a date, and try not to die!

[From [url=https://sadbunnystudio.itch.io/eat-your-heart-valentine-2]Itch.io[/url]]

没工作。没男朋友。房租快到期。情人节也快到了。

来，先给你找份工作，再找个人约会，顺便努力别死！
